title: Glass
description: The element carries the background scene: its fill is mostly transparent, so whatever is behind it (an image, an SVG scene, a gradient) passes straight through it

amount.description: How much of the scene comes through: most (14% tint, the playground hero's "Read the Guide" button), some (22%), least (30%, for busy scenes where text needs more help). Capped at 30% so light text on the element still reads against a dark scene.

--glass-tint.description: The colour mixed into the element. Set it on a container to re-tint every x-glass inside it (the hero sets its on-accent white).

--x-glass-edge-width.description: Width of the faint edge that outlines the element.

--x-glass-blur.description: Softening of the scene behind the element, so text on it stays readable.
